original_result_status: Physical task passed; original primary remains procedurally nonconforming because seven online replies preceded visual review. Do not replace or reclassify it.
geometry_changes_from_original_primary: None. Same XML, mass, inertia, socket, initial placement, fixtures, robot and task.
control_changes: None. Same three control resources, exact thirteen initial finger targets, three experience records, physical criteria and budgets. No tuning, training or original-primary trajectory/experience supplied to the new actor.
workflow_clarification: The skill explicitly requires a completed read-only fresh-image tool result before the model chooses an online reply, then publication in a separate later tool call. This clarifies the original ordering requirement; local withdrawal microactions retain their published state-feedback exception.
image_review_record: For each online reply or skill-selection request sequence, after receiving and inspecting the completed read-only tool result, write actor/image-reviews/NNN.json with request_id, sequence, observation_sha256, two image_sha256 values in request order, result_received_before_reply=true, and a concise visual_review. Publish intent/reply or invoke the local skill in a separate later call. Do not fabricate tool identifiers or timestamps. Local microactions need no model-image review record; the handoff and finish do.
image_evidence_limit: These receipts and the actor's procedural report are attestations bound to saved image bytes, not independent authentication of model perception or tool-result arrival time. Disclose any ordering deviation; saved-file audits alone cannot waive it.
primary_attempts: One separately declared confirmation episode with a fresh independent actor. It is not a new original primary or a new held-out geometry. No changes to frozen inputs during this episode.
acceptance: Complete unchanged physical/quality gates; source, local trace, calibrated grasp, memory/high-target adoption pass; all online/selection image reviews are consistently recorded and actor reports no ordering deviations. Independent procedural review remains separate from physical acceptance.
root_role: Launch, bind, monitor and file-reading support only; no robot strategies or actions supplied.
scope: Confirmation of reproducible source-backed tool use on an already known longer/heavier wrench. No success-rate, unseen-category, vision-only or hardware claim.
external_services: No external model APIs, remote jobs or private-arm simulation.
